history.body: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking for a place to stay ourselves. Can share a bit more?

Sure! The Phase 1 homes are 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. For your own stay, the three bedrooms give you flexibility—perhaps a room for family or guests, or a separate space for work, depending on your needs. Is it mainly for you as a couple, or will family be living with you too?
Just me and my partner for now. We’re renting at the moment and thinking about buying our own place. The balcony sounds nice, but we’re still working out if buying is the right move.

That’s a fair thing to weigh when you’re renting. Since the balcony stood out, I’d suggest seeing the home in person so you can judge whether the layout and balcony feel right for the two of you—viewing doesn’t commit you to buy. What’s weighing on you most: the monthly affordability, or whether you’re ready to own rather than rent?
